comment: Lines of fixtures/text/extracted.json where an extractor does not return the text lamina drew, each with the extractor's limitation behind it (todo B4b). crates/lamina-text/tests/extraction.rs requires every other line to equal the input and every entry here to still match the facts.

exceptions.reason: pdf.js ignores marked-content /ActualText, reads an empty ToUnicode destination (<cid> <>, the dot glyphs Noto Sans Arabic draws apart from their base) as the code (U+0011, U+0003), and the /Span sequences around those clusters split the line into text items it puts in visual order
pdf.js orders right-to-left text items by position and the Hebrew points' offsets split the line into items, so the pieces come out in visual order

exceptions.extracted: नमस्ते दु िनया। िहन्दी पाठ का परीक्षण कमर्
exceptions.reason: pdf.js getTextContent ignores marked-content /ActualText: reordered Devanagari clusters read in drawing order, and the i-matra's negative offset starts a new item (a space)

exceptions.extracted: The words שלום עולם and العالمب ا بمرح mean hello.
exceptions.reason: pdf.js ignores marked-content /ActualText, reads an empty ToUnicode destination (<cid> <>, the dot glyphs Noto Sans Arabic draws apart from their base) as the code (U+0011, U+0003), and the /Span sequences around those clusters split the line into text items it puts in visual order

pypdf reverses right-to-left text piece by piece between TJ position adjustments; the Hebrew points' x offsets split the line, so the pieces come out in visual order (the unpointed Arabic and Hebrew lines extract correctly)

exceptions.extracted: नमस्ते दुिनया। िहन्दी पाठ का परीक्षण कमर्
exceptions.reason: pypdf ignores /ActualText: reordered Devanagari clusters (a pre-base i-matra drawn before its consonant, a reph drawn after it) read in drawing order, each glyph as its own character
